item.title: Your Favourite Day of the Week
item.prompt_text: Say which day of the week is your favourite. Give two reasons, and say what you usually do on that day.
item.target_grammar: present simple with usually, often, always; because
item.fluency_objective: Use 'because' to give your reasons and 'then' to order your day.
item.pronunciation_objective: Stress the day clearly: MONday, FRIday, SATurday, SUNday.
item.model_answer: My favourite day is Sunday. I like Sunday because I don't go to work. I also love it because all my family is at home. On Sunday morning, I usually sleep late. Then we have a big breakfast together. In the afternoon, I often play football with my friends in the park. In the evening, I watch a film.
